If **Delete Account** is available at the bottom of your **Profile**, you can schedule it there: enter your account email to confirm, and deletion is scheduled 30 days out. During that window you can sign in and choose **Keep my account** to cancel. After 30 days, your account and personal data are removed permanently (records in shared workspaces you don't own stay). cases.name: it says a field type cannot be changed after creation
cases.reply:
A field's type can't be changed in place once created: Region is a Text attribute, and converting it to Select isn't something UpdateCustomFieldTool supports, since type is fixed at creation ([custom attribute basics](http://relaticle.test/help/getting-started/use-custom-fields)).

The practical path: create a new Select attribute (e.g. still named "Region", or "Region (new)") with the options you want, then migrate values over manually and delete the old text field once nothing uses it.

Want me to create a new Region select attribute with a set of options you provide?
